title: Instrument panel
source: JoyPro's labels, placed on the photo by looking at it (2026-10-31)

labels.note: Tells the pilot how high the aeroplane is.
Tells the pilot how fast the aeroplane moves through the air.
Shows how heavy the pilot feels in loops and tight turns, so the aeroplane is not overloaded.
Points the way to north, like a hiker's compass.
Shows how hard the engine is pulling and how much fuel it drinks.
Shows that the engine has enough oil and is not too hot.
Shows how fast the engine and the propeller turn.
Small switches for the aeroplane's electrics.
